title: Witney Carson Is Pregnant and Returning for ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Season 35
summary: The professional dancer reflects on her first-of-its-kind casting in conversation with THR, and the announcement that Guillermo Rodriguez will be her celebrity partner for the upcoming season: "If I can do both and the baby is healthy, then I am gonna try and do it all, because women are amazing."
